planets.name: TOI-4364 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4364 with a 5.42-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-4364 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-4364. Its orbit and size follow Distler et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
